sections.title: Why Sessionplan works better than a spreadsheet
sections.content:
Spreadsheets and Word documents are how most people start planning sessions. They work – until you move something. Change one block's duration and you're manually recalculating every start time that follows.

Sessionplan gives you a proper planning workspace built around time:

  • Visual timeline: Every block sits on a real timeline. You see your full session at a glance.
  • Drag & drop: Move a block and every start time after it updates instantly. No maths, no reformatting.
  • Auto-calculated totals: The running duration and end time update in real time as you build your plan
  • No sign-up: Open the app and start. Your plans are saved in your browser – nothing in the cloud.
  • Share via link: One URL sends your complete session plan to anyone who needs it

sections.title: Everything you need to plan and run a session

items.title: Flexible block types
items.description: Create custom block categories to match your format – or start from the defaults like input, activity, discussion, break and energiser.

items.title: Groups and breakouts
items.description: Bundle related blocks into collapsible phases, or plan parallel tracks for subgroups and teams.

items.title: Live Mode
items.description: Activate Live Mode when the session starts. A slim overlay shows you the active block, time remaining and what comes next.

items.title: Block library and templates
items.description: Save frequently used blocks and drop them into any new plan, or save full session structures to reuse across formats.

items.title: Share via link
items.description: Send your complete session plan as a single URL. No files, no email attachments.

items.title: JSON export and import
items.description: Save plans locally or transfer to another device with a portable JSON file.

sections.title: Sessionplan vs. SessionLab
sections.content:
SessionLab is a well-known paid tool for workshop design. Here's how Sessionplan compares for people who need something lighter:

  • Completely free – SessionLab's free tier is limited; Sessionplan has no tiers
  • No account required – Start immediately, nothing to sign up for
  • Private by default – Data stays in your browser; optional server sync via Dynamic Link
  • Faster to start – No onboarding, no tutorial required

If you need team collaboration features or a library tied to a cloud account, SessionLab may be worth the cost. If you want something fast, private and free, Sessionplan is purpose-built for that.

sections.title: Who uses Sessionplan
sections.content:
Anyone who plans time-structured sessions:

  • Trainers and coaches – Professional training days, coaching workshops, seminars
  • Facilitators and Scrum Masters – Retrospectives, sprint plannings, team offsites
  • Teachers and lecturers – Lesson plans, lecture schedules, course modules
  • Event producers – Run-of-show documents, conference agendas, live show plans
  • Podcast producers – Episode outlines with segment timings
  • Dungeon Masters – D&D session prep with encounter timings and act structure

sections.title: Free, ad-free and private by design

items.label: 100% free
items.description: No subscription, no premium tier, no expiry.

items.label: Your data stays with you
items.description: By default, everything stays in your browser.

items.question: Is Sessionplan really free?
items.answer: Yes – completely. No subscription, no premium features gated behind a paywall, no trial period. Everything is available from the moment you open Sessionplan.de.

items.question: Do I need to create an account?
items.answer: No. Open Sessionplan.de and start planning. Your sessions are saved in your browser's local storage – no email, no password.

items.question: What happens if I close the tab?
items.answer: Your work is saved automatically in your browser's local storage and can be restored when you come back – as long as you're on the same device and haven't cleared browser data. Use the share link or JSON export to back up plans you want to keep long-term.

items.question: How do I share a session plan?
items.answer: Use the Share button to generate a link. Anyone who opens the link sees your full plan in their browser. You can also export as JSON in the settings for offline backups or to import on another device.

items.question: Does it work offline?
items.answer: Yes. Once the app has loaded, you can plan without an internet connection. Useful for workshops in locations with unreliable WiFi.

items.question: Can I use it for things other than workshops?
items.answer: Yes – anything with a time structure works: retrospectives, run-of-show documents, podcast episodes, D&D sessions, lesson plans. The underlying structure is the same: blocks, timings, a timeline.
